name: Cynthia Gonzalez
office: City of Cudahy, Member of the City Council

items.text: Cynthia Gonzalez is the mayor of Cudahy and a city council member whose term began in 2022. She directs a Los Angeles Unified School District pilot schools program and holds a UCLA doctorate in educational leadership.

sentences.text: Cynthia Gonzalez is the mayor of Cudahy and a city council member whose term began in 2022.
She directs a Los Angeles Unified School District pilot schools program and holds a UCLA doctorate in educational leadership.

items.text: Her campaign says she helped pass Cudahy’s first rent-stabilization ordinance and resolutions supporting a ceasefire, domestic violence prevention, and students’ right to protest. She says she also established committees on city beautification, food vendors, and community safety. In 2025, she posted and removed a video that appeared to call on street gangs to organize against immigration raids, drawing public backlash. She apologized at a city council meeting, calling the video “satirical” and saying her message was not about violence.
